verdict.rationale: Docs confirm LiteLLM's Router supports load-balancing across multiple deployments/providers with cooldowns, retries, timeouts and automatic failover to healthy backups (litellm-docs-3, litellm-docs-4, litellm-docs-21, litellm-docs-28, litellm-docs-30), and queueing/prioritization for important requests (litellm-docs-29). However, the evidence pack never explicitly names weight-based, latency-based, or cost-based routing strategies (LiteLLM's actual router supports these, but no citation here confirms it), and community comments note real-world flakiness/outages (litellm-comm-4), tempering confidence. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/citation of weight-based routing strategy, explicit latency-based routing strategy, explicit cost-based routing strategy, and independent verification that these balancing modes work reliably in production.
